readings.Aries: You thrive in motion. Today the most important motion is internal. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Taurus: The season is changing. Not outside — inside. You feel it already. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Gemini: You've told the story of yourself differently to different people. Which version is closest to true? The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Cancer: Something you're grieving is not the thing you think you're grieving. Look under it. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Leo: You require appreciation the way cells require oxygen. Name this without shame. The first instinct was right.
readings.Virgo: Routine is not limitation. For you, it is the condition under which everything else becomes possible. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Libra: Someone has been telling you what you want to hear. You already know this. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Scorpio: The past is not gone — it's metabolised. What has your history made you capable of? Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Sagittarius: You said the true thing. Consider also the timing and the delivery. The first instinct was right.
readings.Capricorn: There is warmth in you that your efficiency sometimes buries. Let it surface. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Aquarius: The independence you protect is real and necessary. Today it is being used defensively rather than freely. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Pisces: There is a memory that's been present at the edge of your consciousness for days. Look at it directly. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.

sky_notes: Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
First quarter: Moon and Sun are ~90° apart, so exactly half the visible disc is lit. Tides are at their weakest (neap) around now.
Mars and Jupiter are within 0.3° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
